flow.name: customers-list-flow
flow.doc:description: One mode per call (ids, email/phone, or page); passes the query to sapi-crm GET /contacts

ee:transform.doc:description: Query parameters for sapi-crm; ids with email/phone is invalid

choice.doc:description: ids cannot be combined with email or phone

raise-error.description: Use one mode per call: ids, email/phone, or page and size

http:request.doc:description: One call to sapi-crm (a batch of ids is a single SOQL query there)

flow.name: customers-get-flow
flow.doc:description: One customer by Salesforce Id; 404 when it does not exist

try.doc:description: sapi-crm answers 404 for an unknown Id

on-error-propagate.doc:description: The contact does not exist in Salesforce

flow.name: customers-register-flow
flow.doc:description: Email or phone required; an existing email returns 409 (search first, Salesforce duplicate rule as the backstop, D22)

set-variable.doc:description: Keeps the request: each HTTP call replaces the payload

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - Register customer, name: ' ++ vars.customerRequest.name ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the registration

choice.doc:description: A customer needs an email or a phone

raise-error.description: The customer needs an email or a phone

choice.doc:description: The duplicate rule is by email

http:request.doc:description: Is there already a contact with this email?

choice.doc:description: A contact with the email means the customer already exists

raise-error.description: A customer with this email already exists

http:request.doc:description: Creates the contact in Salesforce through sapi-crm; a 409 is a valid answer

choice.doc:description: Two registrations at the same time: the Salesforce duplicate rule blocks the second one (D22)

raise-error.description: A customer with this email already exists

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - Register customer, id: ' ++ (payload.id default '') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the Salesforce Id of the new customer
